headline: Aster DM Healthcare: NCLT approves Scheme of Amalgamation
sum: Aster DM Healthcare Limited received NCLT approval from the National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench, for a Scheme of Amalgamation; regulatory filing made to NSE on 19 June 2026.
detail: The National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench, passed a final order approving the Scheme of Amalgamation. The specific counterparty entity, share swap ratio, and effective date have not been disclosed in publicly available sources as of the announcement.
